name: Nashville
housing: Nashville renters live in apartment complexes, new mid- and high-rises in the core, and rented bungalows and townhouses.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid Society of Middle Tennessee and the Cumberlands
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters, including eviction

climate: Test the air conditioning and look for water damage; summers are hot and humid and storms can flood low areas.
fact: Tennessee's landlord-tenant law does not give renters a right to air conditioning, so check it works before you sign.
